short.en_US: XBT Lightning node with wallet and channel dashboard

long.en_US: Core Lightning on the BLAKE2b chain, with the CLN Application dashboard. Requires synced, unpruned BLAKE2b Knots. Fresh-wallet candidate; importing existing Lightning state and migrating installed experimental XBT channels are not supported. Bounded swap coordinator support requires explicit setup and reviewed grants.

releaseNotes.en_US: Restore the bundled native gRPC plugin and explicitly load gRPC and CLNrest as required by the node configuration. Preserve the existing wallet, channels, UI and swap journals during a normal update.

description.en_US: Synced, unpruned BLAKE2b Knots with the pinned activation checkpoint. The bitcoind package ID alone does not identify the chain.
